title: On top of that · phrase
subtitle: 「此外／而且／再加上／再說」，究竟是哪一種 on top of that？
description: 「此外／而且／再加上／再說」，究竟是哪一種 on top of that？

words.note: 使用者提供。furthermore 是 on top of that 的正式書面近義詞，表示在已有理由、事實或論點之外再補充一點。它常見於 essays, reports, formal arguments。
words.example: The proposal is expensive; furthermore, it would take years to implement.

exercises.original: The plan is expensive. On top of that, it would require additional staff.
exercises.zh: 這個計劃成本高。此外，還需要額外人手。

words.meaning: 而且；更重要的是；再加上

exercises.original: She teaches history. On top of that, she also runs the school debate club.
exercises.zh: 她教授歷史，而且也負責學校辯論隊。

options.explanation: the second role is simply another fact about the same person.

falseSynonyms.zh: furthermore 較正式，常見於論證與報告；on top of that 更口語，也常帶累積感。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Furthermore, the proposal is expensive. On top of that, we'd need extra staff.

falseSynonyms.word: on top of that / in addition
falseSynonyms.zh: in addition 最中性，可單純增加一項資訊；on top of that 往往更強調『再加上一點』。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON In addition, breakfast is included. On top of that, parking is free.

falseSynonyms.zh: moreover 通常進一步強化前面論點；普通列舉資訊未必需要這種論證感。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Moreover, the evidence is weak. In addition, the report includes an appendix.

falseSynonyms.zh: besides 常有『再說／況且』的理由補充功能；on top of that 可以只是增加事實。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Besides, it would cost too much. On top of that, the package includes breakfast.

falseSynonyms.zh: also 是句內加法副詞，語氣較弱；on top of that 更像獨立 discourse connector。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She also teaches French. On top of that, she runs the club.

falseSynonyms.zh: therefore 表示因果結果『因此』；on top of that 只是加一點，沒有必然因果。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The road was closed; therefore, we turned back. The road was closed. On top of that, it was snowing.

falseSynonyms.zh: however 表示轉折；on top of that 表示累加，功能相反。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The room is small; however, it is bright. The room is small. On top of that, it is noisy.

falseSynonyms.word: on top of that / to make matters worse
falseSynonyms.zh: to make matters worse 只適合加入更壞的負面情況；on top of that 可以加優點、缺點或中性資訊。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The car broke down; to make matters worse, it began to rain. The hotel is cheap; on top of that, breakfast is included.
